title: Delete dead HebrewTerms.getCurriculumDisplayName — unused, violates Rule 5 displayNameHe placement, tested twice by duplicate groups
why: A repo-wide grep of lib/ finds zero production callers of HebrewTerms.getCurriculumDisplayName — the only call sites are two duplicate, identically-named test groups (lines 73 and 102, in the same file) that both just re-assert `== id.displayNameHe`, a tautology restating the implementation. The method also lives in core/constants/, not core/labels/, so its `.displayNameHe` access bypasses the Rule 5 placement boundary that the no_curriculum_display_name_bypass custom lint would flag if custom_lint weren't currently broken (per baseline). core/labels/curriculum_label.dart already has the equivalent, correctly-placed `_curriculumId!.displayNameHe` access, confirming this delegate is a superseded leftover (the doc comment even says the map it replaced was removed 'to eliminate duplication').
recommendation: Delete HebrewTerms.getCurriculumDisplayName and both duplicate test groups. If Hebrew curriculum-name lookup is still needed outside core/labels/, route through CurriculumLabelRenderer per Rule 5 instead of a raw `.displayNameHe` access.
acceptance_criteria: `grep -rn getCurriculumDisplayName lib/ test/` returns no results after removal
hebrew_terms_test.dart no longer has two groups named 'getCurriculumDisplayName'

corrections: A third call site exists: test/story_acceptance/epic_18_track_overhaul_test.dart:511-520 also calls HebrewTerms.getCurriculumDisplayName in a tautological assertion. The finding's 'sites: 2' and 'the only call sites are two duplicate test groups' undercounts by one file; deleting per the stated recommendation alone would break that acceptance test.
